name: Malilla
summary: Four-player fixed-partnership point-trick game with 40 cards where the seven is the highest card.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships sit opposite with a 40-card Spanish pack. Deal all cards counter-clockwise; the dealer's last card is face up and sets trumps, scoring its points as immediate bonus unless it would win the game. Player to dealer's right leads first. Follow suit if possible, and if an opponent is winning you must beat the winning card if you can; when void you must trump if opponent leads suit, or overtrump if opponent trumps. You may not discard a seven of a non-trump suit that has never been led. Highest trump wins trick, else highest of suit led; winner leads next. Ten tricks per hand. Each trick is 1 point plus card values: Seven 5, Ace 4, King 3, Horse/Queen 2, Jack 1. Total 70. Team over 35 scores difference; first team to 35 cumulative wins. Winning all ten tricks wins instantly.
